notes: No source found that compares FDIC consent-order rates for minority depository institutions with other banks, for 2020-26 or any period. Searches surfaced FDIC MDI policy pages, the FDIC OIG 2019 MDI program summary (no enforcement data), and academic work on how enforcement actions change banks' lending to minority borrowers (a different question). Several WebSearch calls auto-expanded into multiple internal searches (queries 1 and 4 each returned five result sets), so real search use for this story is higher than the five logged queries; stopped at five for that reason.
